text:
Hi there, and thank you for contacting Leafy! I love that you picked up a snake plant, and it's great that you're keeping an eye on prices.

Unfortunately, I'm not able to offer a price adjustment in this case. Our price drop policy covers purchases made within 7 days, and your plant is within that window at 5 days. However, flash sales are specifically excluded from it, so the difference wouldn't be issued as store credit.

I know that's not the news you were hoping for, and I'm sorry about that. Here's what I can tell you:

- Price drops (outside of flash sales and clearance) within 7 days of purchase are refunded as store credit, once per item.
- Flash sale pricing doesn't qualify, so I can't promise an adjustment here.

If you'd like, I can pass your request to a Support Lead to review, though I can't guarantee a different outcome.

Is there anything else I can help with, like care tips to help your snake plant thrive? Our Plant Care Specialists are always happy to chat. Thanks again for being part of the Leafy family!
